architecture_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a PROFESSIONAL Chinese engineering architecture poster for the project, portrait 3:4, approximately 1536x2048. Premium midnight navy background, white and cyan text, faint technical grid, restrained violet accents, clean modern Chinese typography. Diagram accuracy and mobile readability are more important than decoration. Exact large title: "PS–PL 协同系统框架". Exact subtitle: "ZYNQ UltraScale+ MPSoC · FZ3B 开发板". FZ3B is the BOARD name, never label a semiconductor FZ3B.
Technical structure, with organized generous spacing and real directional arrows:
At top, one HOST card titled "Windows 主机端", with four short lines "中文描述与离线翻译", "MobileCLIP 文本编码", "视频解码与帧上传", "可视化与片段导出".
Below HOST, a vertical BIDIRECTIONAL Ethernet connection into a large board enclosure, explicitly titled "以太网"; down arrow "文本特征 / 上传帧", up arrow "视频 / 检索结果".
The board enclosure is titled "FZ3B 开发板" with smaller "ZYNQ UltraScale+"; it contains a LEFT module titled "PS · Cortex-A53 / Linux" with body "采集 · 预处理 · 模型分区", a RIGHT module titled "PL · RTL008" with body "手写 RTL + AMD 标准 IP" and "CNN 算子加速". A bidirectional internal arrow connects PS and PL labeled "AXI + DDR". UNDER PS, a small module titled "双 R5 / TCM" with "匹配与协议辅助", connected only to PS. A separate small "UVC 摄像头" card outside/left of the board feeds an arrow INTO the PS module labeled "USB".
Below the board, footer badges "离线中文查询", "PS–PL 协同", "三端源码开源". Exact small repo footer "Geruyang/fz3b-semantic-video-search".
Do not show any extra hardware photos or fake board PCB, do not add metrics, do not imply R5 owns the physical camera or Ethernet drivers, do not say the text encoder executes in PL. All displayed Chinese text must be clear, exact, properly spaced and without typos. Keep minimum 7% margins. Neat publication-quality systems engineering diagram, visually striking but strictly readable.
route_base_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a matching PROFESSIONAL Chinese technical roadmap poster for the same semantic video retrieval project, portrait 3:4 approximately 1536x2048. Midnight navy background, white/cyan typography, violet for one branch, subtle grid, restrained luminous connection lines. Prioritize exact architecture and very legible Chinese text over decoration. Exact large title "从中文查询到视频片段". Exact subtitle "MobileCLIP-S1 · 语义检索技术路线".
Main diagram starts with TWO parallel, clearly separated top-to-bottom processing lanes:
LEFT lane heading "文本分支 · Windows 主机"; nodes in this exact order: "中文描述" → "离线翻译" → "MobileCLIP 文本编码" → "文本特征".
RIGHT lane heading "视觉分支 · PS–PL"; nodes in this exact order: "摄像头 / 已有视频" → "采集 / 解码与预处理" → "PS–PL 视觉推理" → "图像特征".
Both final feature nodes converge via two arrows INTO a central wide node "余弦相似度匹配". It then flows downward sequentially through "阈值筛选" → "连续片段整理" → "命中时间段" → "浏览与导出". Use compact horizontal arrangement for last three if needed, but direction and sequence must be unambiguous. Include one precise small note: "PL 加速部分 CNN 算子，文本编码在主机完成". Exact footer hardware line "芯片：ZYNQ UltraScale+ ｜ 板卡：FZ3B". Add one short explanatory caption "文本与图像在同一语义空间匹配".
Do not invent dimensions, FPS, accuracy numbers or classification/detection bounding boxes. Do not treat similarity as a probability. Existing-video decoding can happen in the host; camera capture happens in PS Linux, so the input stage intentionally uses general capture/decoding wording. No fake board photographs. Large clean Chinese text, balanced spacing and minimum 7% margins, high-end professional engineering poster suitable for a technical project promotion post.
route_final_correction: Use case: text-localization. Edit this technical roadmap poster with precisely TWO small wording corrections. (1) In the LEFT branch box headed "MobileCLIP 文本编码", replace the small subtitle "中文 / 英文文本编码" with exactly "英文文本特征提取". This project translates Chinese queries offline before the text encoder, so do not imply direct Chinese text encoding. (2) In the bottom box headed "命中时间段", replace its small subtitle "输出匹配的视频片段" with exactly "定位匹配的时间区间". Video clips are exported in the following browse/export step. Preserve all other words, main title, arrows, diagram geometry, color, layout, illustration, grid, dimensions and style exactly. These are targeted text corrections only, do not redraw or add content. Keep the label "ZYNQ UltraScale+" as the chip and "FZ3B" as the board.
